title: Dow, S&P 500 close at records on AI results, Mideast deal hopes
title_zh: 道指、标准普尔 500 指数收盘人工智能业绩创历史新高，中东交易希望
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes surged on Tuesday, with the Dow and S&P 500 both gaining roughly one-and-three quarters percent to notch record-high closes, and the Nasdaq climbing more than two-and-a-half percent.Investors eagerly awaited SpaceX's first earnings results sin...
summary_zh: 故事：周二，华尔街主要股指飙升，道指和标准普尔 500 指数均上涨约百分之一又四分之三，创下收盘纪录新高，纳斯达克指数上涨逾百分之二半。投资者热切等待 SpaceX 自 2018 年以来的首次财报。

title: Arista forecasts upbeat quarterly revenue on AI-driven networking demand
title_zh: Arista 预测人工智能驱动的网络需求将带来乐观的季度收入
summary: Arista Networks forecast third-quarter revenue above Wall Street ‌estimates on Tuesday, betting on strong ‌demand for its networking gear as companies ​expand their AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: Arista Networks 周二预测第三季度收入将高于华尔街的预期，并押注随着公司扩展其人工智能基础设施，对其网络设备的强劲需求。

title: SpaceX teams up with Nvidia: Musk says Vera Rubin is 'the best AI computer'
title_zh: SpaceX 与 Nvidia 合作：马斯克称 Vera Rubin 是“最好的 AI 计算机”
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk is teaming up exclusively with AI leader Nvidia (NVDA) for its AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 正在与人工智能领导者 Nvidia (NVDA) 独家合作开发人工智能基础设施。

title: 'This was not an exceptional result': Strategist talks AMD earnings & 'shocking' capex
title_zh: “这不是一个特殊的结果”：策略师谈论 AMD 收益和“令人震惊的”资本支出
summary: AMD (AMD) reported second quarter results on Tuesday after the closing bell.
summary_zh: AMD（AMD）周二收盘后公布了第二季度业绩。

title: Pinterest expects slower quarterly revenue growth as ad competition heats up
title_zh: 随着广告竞争加剧，Pinterest 预计季度收入增长放缓
summary: Image-sharing platform Pinterest forecast slower revenue growth for the third quarter on Tuesday, a sign of tough ‌competition for digital advertising from bigger players including Meta's Instagram, sending its ‌shares down 9% in extended trading.
summary_zh: 图片共享平台 Pinterest 周二预测第三季度收入增长放缓，这表明来自 Meta 旗下 Instagram 等大型企业对数字广告的激烈竞争，导致其股价在盘后交易中下跌 9%。

title: US dollar shaken after intervention to strengthen Japanese yen
title_zh: 干预日元走强后美元震荡
summary: The US dollar (DX-Y.NYB) has weakened after the US and Japan jointly intervened to boost the yen. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at the dollar's decline and the yen's growing strength, comparing it to prior events in the yen's history.
summary_zh: 在美国和日本联合干预提振日元后，美元(DX-Y.NYB)走弱。雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 仔细研究了美元的下跌和日元的走强，并将其与日元历史上的先前事件进行了比较。

title: SpaceX profitability will come down to Starlink's success: Lee Munson
title_zh: Lee Munson：SpaceX 的盈利能力将取决于星链的成功
summary: As SpaceX (SPCX) prepares to release its first-ever earnings report after Tuesday's market close, investors are beginning to wonder whether Elon Musk's space venture is overvalued or not.
summary_zh: 随着 SpaceX (SPCX) 准备在周二收盘后发布其首份收益报告，投资者开始怀疑埃隆·马斯克的太空事业是否被高估。

title: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 soar to record highs, Nasdaq rallies on hopes for a Hormuz deal
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数飙升至历史新高，纳斯达克指数因霍尔木兹协议的希望而上涨
summary: Markets are coming off a Big Tech rally, eyeing uncertainty in Middle East talks and  SpaceX earnings after the bell.
summary_zh: 市场正经历大型科技股的反弹，关注中东谈判和 SpaceX 收盘后盈利的不确定性。

title: Tech stocks today: SpaceX and AMD post quarterly results; investors weren't impressed.
title_zh: 今日科技股：SpaceX 和 AMD 发布季度业绩；投资者没有留下深刻的印象。
summary: Tech stocks coverage for the week of Aug. 3.
summary_zh: 8 月 3 日当周科技股报道。
